title: Minnesota Statutes, Chapter 181 - Employment (final payment of wages on discharge or quitting, s. 181.13-181.14; restrictive covenants; notices)
verified_how: Fetched https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/181 (HTTP 200): '2025 Minnesota Statutes', 'CHAPTER 181. EMPLOYMENT', plus an in-page notice 'This chapter has been affected by law enacted during the 2026 Regular Session' listing amendments to 181.101 (2026 ch. 106, art. 15, s. 5) and 181.211 subd. 10 (2026 ch. 88, art. 1, s. 85). Also fetched section page /statutes/cite/181.13 (HTTP 200, '2025 Minnesota Statutes').
notes: In force; the 2025 edition text is pending integration of 2026 session amendments to ss. 181.101 and 181.211. Minnesota has no general statutory severance-pay entitlement; this chapter is the principal statute governing the consequences of termination for pay purposes.
